description: This PHP file defines a LocalizationController class within the OrangeHRM system's admin module. The class extends a Vue controller and utilizes traits for localization services to prepare localization configuration data for rendering in a Vue.js component.

classes.name: LocalizationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing localization settings in the admin interface, providing localization data to the Vue.js front-end component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares localization configuration data (supported languages and date formats) and binds it to a Vue.js component for rendering.
